metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Captures the same bubbly, fashionable, and surprisingly smart energy found in Clueless.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A essential teen comedy that mirrors the high school social dynamics of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Features the same irreverent humor, colorful visuals, and sci-fi adventure as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A quintessential comfort movie that blends fantasy, romance, and comedy like Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The direct predecessor to Wake Up Dead Man, offering high-stakes mystery with a fun, comedic twist.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A hilarious and fast-paced comedy-thriller that matches the chemistry-driven humor of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A witty modern teen comedy with a strong lead, perfect for fans of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A charming and whimsical fantasy adventure that aligns with the tone of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-concept action comedy with video game logic that feels very similar to the new Jumanji films.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: High-octane action mixed with quirky character comedy, echoing the style of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A fun, stylized take on the spy genre with plenty of action and comedic flair.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, it features the same sharp-witted buddy-comedy dialogue found in The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A high-energy action comedy that blends slapstick with genuine thrills, similar to Ace Ventura's investigative antics.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A lighthearted heist movie with a colorful cast, matching the crime-comedy vibe of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: If you enjoyed the absurd character-driven humor of Brüno, this fashion-world satire is a perfect match.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: Features Sacha Baron Cohen’s signature mockumentary style that you enjoyed in Brüno.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: A fun, anachronistic medieval adventure starring Heath Ledger that mirrors the spirit of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A feel-good blend of live-action fantasy and rom-com tropes that fits your 'Light and Fun' preference.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The gold standard for fun adventure-comedy, perfectly matching the tone of Jumanji and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Widely considered the ultimate comfort movie; it is uplifting, funny, and incredibly well-crafted.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action movies that delivers genuine excitement and top-tier comedy.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A high-energy reboot that balances action and high school comedy perfectly.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A fun, lighthearted ensemble comedy with a great soundtrack, similar in vibe to Clueless.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever time-loop rom-com that is both funny and easy to watch, fitting your comfort cinema criteria.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: A charming, musical feel-good story that is lighthearted and very easy to enjoy.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a light fantasy element, much like the grounded magic in Practical Magic.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A magical-realist comedy that offers an uplifting escape into history and romance.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic action-fantasy that doesn't take itself too seriously, similar to Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: The peak of 'cool' crime comedy, matching the smooth, professional wit of Get Shorty.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A tropical adventure rom-com that feels like a modern throwback to the fun energy of Jumanji.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A fun, comedic take on the survival genre that balances light scares with big laughs like Anaconda.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually inventive action-comedy that shares the high-energy spirit of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A hilarious mockumentary for fans of the cringe-comedy and musical satire seen in Brüno.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern teen classic that updates the Clueless formula with a fresh, heartwarming friendship focus.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly charming creature-feature adventure that is much more lighthearted than a typical apocalypse movie.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All At Once
metas.description: While epic, it is fundamentally a high-energy, funny, and deeply moving experience for fans of fantasy and adventure.

metas.name: Coming to America
metas.description: A classic fish-out-of-water comedy that provides pure, nostalgic comfort.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Classic Jim Carrey energy that fans of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective will immediately appreciate.

metas.name: Practical Magic
metas.description: A cozy, supernatural romance that matches your taste for light fantasy and sisterhood themes.

metas.name: Kiki's Delivery Service
metas.description: A beautifully animated feel-good movie about a young witch, perfect for fans of Practical Magic.
